The '''''Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon'' arc''' (Japanese: '''第十四章　サン・ムーン・ウルトラサン・ウルトラムーン編''' ''The Fourteenth Chapter: Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc''), originally published in magazines as the '''''Sun & Moon'' arc''' (Japanese: '''サン・ムーン編''' ''Sun & Moon arc''), is the fourteenth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It began serialization in November 2016, and ended in November 2019.

The arc follows the adventures of {{adv|Sun}}, a courier that aims to gather 100 million yen for a classified purpose, and {{adv|Moon}}, a pharmacist from [[Sinnoh]] who traveled to [[Alola]] to deliver a {{adv|Rotom Pokédex|Rotom}} to [[Professor Kukui]]. When the [[Guardian deities|Tapu]] start to get angry for some reason, the [[island kahuna]]s choose to resurrect the old tradition of the [[island challenge]] in the hopes of appeasing them, with Sun getting chosen to carry out this task. Meanwhile, the threat of an [[Ultra Beast]] invasion looms over the region due to the actions of [[Aether Foundation]] President [[Lusamine]] and [[Team Skull]] Boss [[Guzma]]. Branch Chief [[Faba]] is determined to use this opportunity to take over the Aether Foundation and destroy Lusamine's family to enact a twisted revenge on her for not accepting his lustful feelings towards her.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon Sun and Moon]] and [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]].

==Volumes==
* {{PAV|65}}
===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures Sun & Moon volumes}}
As with the two arcs before it, the ''Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon'' arc was collected separately into mini-volumes. The [[Pokémon Adventures Sun & Moon volume 1|first volume]] was released on June 23, 2017, with the final volume released on December 27, 2019.

These volumes have also been localized in English by [[Shogakukan Asia]].

====United States====
{{main|List of Pokémon Sun & Moon volumes}}
An English translation of the ''Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon'' arc was released by [[VIZ Media]] under the title '''Pokémon Sun & Moon''', which was released in their own mini-volumes as with the two arcs before it. The [[Pokémon Sun & Moon volume 1|first volume]] was released on May 8, 2018, with the final volume released on January 11, 2022.
